title: City Budget: Spending, Services, Workforce Focus
summary:
*   The City Manager presented the proposed 1989-90 financial plan, outlining future city spending.
*   This comprehensive budget covered operating expenses, capital investments, and key policy initiatives.
*   Core objectives emphasized were living within the city's financial means, protecting essential services, and investing in the municipal workforce.

Mayor Cooke called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Councilmember Humphrey. Mayor Cooke announced the purpose of the meeting was to listen
to the City Manager's budget presentation to Council.
City Manager Barnett introduced her discussion by stating there were three objectives in
the budget: 1. Live within our means 2. Protect services 3. Invest in the work force. She
explained the proposed 1989-90 Financial Plan and illustrated with charts and graphs. In
additon to the Operating Budget, the Capital Budget and Policy Budget were also introduced
and explained.
The Council adjourned its meeting at 12:17 Ρ.Μ.
